title: Restriction of the published finite open projection formula
statement: Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring and $j:U\hookrightarrow X$ an open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion]. In the ordinary unbounded derived categories $D_A(U)$ and $D_A(X)$ use the actual exact pullback $j^*$, extension $j_!$, adjunction unit $\eta$, tensor comparison $\mu$, and projection map $\gamma$ of [def-sf-finite-open-tensor-operations]. For every $M\in D_A(U)$ and $N\in D_A(X)$, $j^*\gamma_{M,N}$ equals $\mu_{j;j_!M,N}$ followed by $(\eta_M^{-1}\otimes 1_{j^*N})$ and then $\eta_{M\otimes j^*N}$. The inverse of $\eta_M$ is the canonical inverse of the section-normalized open unit of [lem-sf-open-tensor-normalization]. No constructibility, boundedness, or Tor-amplitude is assumed.

source.place: Open-extension symmetry reduction; explicit finite-presentation transport of the tensor calculation in Steps 1--3 of lem-pur-two-open-tensor-chain-normalization. proof.text:
the published projection map p is the adjoint transpose of the tensor
of the open unit with the identity, followed by the inverse mixed tensor
comparison t. Hence eta followed by pull(p) equals tensor(eta,1) followed by t.
Cancel pull(p), using the actual projection isomorphism and the invertible
open unit, to obtain pull(p inverse) = t inverse followed by tensor(eta inverse,1)
and eta. The definition of gamma then postcomposes p inverse by extension of
the comparison from left-derived to exact pullback in its second tensor input.
Naturality of eta moves this factor before the final eta. Expand t and the
published tensorPullIso; they have the same pullback identification and derived
tensor comparison. Naturality of the tensor bifunctor moves the second-input
comparison past tensor(eta inverse,1), giving exactly the displayed formula.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteOpenGammaRestriction (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    {U X : Scheme.{u}} (j : U ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion j]
    (M : FiniteD A U) (N : FiniteD A X) :
    (pull A j).map (gamma A j M N) =
      (tensorPullIso A j ((finiteShriek A j).obj M) N).hom ≫
        tensorMap A U (inv ((adj A j).unit.app M)) (𝟙 ((pull A j).obj N)) ≫
        (adj A j).unit.app (tensor A U M ((pull A j).obj N))
lean.note: The additional public instance proves invertibility of the actual derived open unit by exact localization of the existing fully faithful open adjunction; no data construction or adjunction is changed.
